gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-syriac-e: Loosely spaced like separate paper cut-outs, Press Start 2P gives its lowercase big open bowls and a retro, playful grin. Noto Sans Syriac Eastern carries paragraphs, its curve endings never crowding each other.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Press Start 2P is the fun, retro one, with big open lowercase bowls and faint modulation. Noto Sans Tagalog does the quieter job, with generous curve gaps and a middle-heavy line.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Playful from the first letter, Press Start 2P has big open lowercase bowls and a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight. Noto Sans Tagbanwa keeps paragraphs clean, its open curves leaving clear gaps.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Noto Sans Tai Le reads neutral and approachable, its ink strokes tapering off before they touch. And across paragraphs the small step from capitals to lowercase keeps things smooth, with Press Start 2P adding retro fun above.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Noto Sans Tai Tham packs chalk-board lowercase up toward the capital line, yet the inside of its c stays clearly visible. But Press Start 2P, with its slight thick-thin variation, earns its keep big and brief.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Press Start 2P is fun and retro, with big open lowercase bowls and mild, never stark, contrast. Noto Sans Tai Viet has a tall x-height, so a small heading would get outshone.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Press Start 2P goes for fun and retro, with middling stroke contrast and big open lowercase bowls. Noto Sans Tangsa takes the steadier job, with wide round openings and short ascenders.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Fun and retro, Press Start 2P brings a soft fat-and-slim stroke difference and big open lowercase bowls. Noto Sans Telugu sits below with a high-set midline and counters open to the outside, a sober partner.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-thai-loo: Big open lowercase bowls give Press Start 2P its grin. Noto Sans Thai Looped looks bold because its lowercase bodies run tall, yet gaps at the curve terminals keep paragraphs moving.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Press Start 2P adds a gentle weight change where its bowls curve around, with fun retro spirit. Noto Sans Tirhuta supplies the best part, its dominant x-height and terminals cut back to leave a big gap.
